requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the product catalog

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available ceramics products
Products that are out of stock are visibly distinguishable in the catalog

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a product's details before buying

criteria.must: The product detail view shows photos, description, price, and stock availability

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add products to a cart and adjust quantities

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
Changing a cart item's quantity updates the cart total
Removing a cart item removes it from the cart

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out as a guest without creating an account

criteria.must: A shopper can complete checkout without signing in

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in via SSO to check out with an account and view order history later

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in via SSO before checkout
An order placed while signed in is associated with the shopper's account

requirements.statement: Shoppers pay by card through a hosted payment checkout

criteria.must: Checkout routes the shopper to a hosted card-payment checkout
A failed or declined payment does not create a paid order

requirements.statement: A flat shipping fee is applied and shown at checkout

criteria.must: The checkout total includes a flat shipping fee shown separately from the item subtotal
The shipping fee is the same regardless of order contents or destination

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive confirmation that their order was placed

criteria.must: After successful payment the shopper sees an order confirmation with an order reference

requirements.statement: Signed-in shoppers can view their past orders and status

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's order history lists their previously placed orders
Each listed order shows its current status
A signed-in shopper cannot view another shopper's orders

requirements.statement: The Store Admin signs in via SSO to a protected admin area

criteria.must: The admin area requires sign-in before any admin action is available
A shopper without the admin role cannot access the admin area

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can create, edit, and remove catalog products

criteria.must: The admin can create a new product with photos, description, and price
The admin can edit an existing product's details
The admin can remove a product, after which it no longer appears in the shopper catalog

requirements.statement: The Store Admin tracks inventory so out-of-stock items stop being sold

criteria.must: The admin can update a product's stock quantity
A product with zero stock cannot be added to a shopper's cart

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can view incoming orders and update their status

criteria.must: The admin can view a list of all orders
The admin can update an order's status (e.g. paid, shipped, delivered)
A status update is visible to the shopper in their order history
